name: timeout
summary: POST /api/bulk buffers the entire request body into memory with no size limit; an oversized payload exhausts the Node.js heap and aborts the process.
expected_log_signature: FATAL ERROR: Reached heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory
ground_truth: POST /api/bulk reads the whole request body and concatenates it into a single string without any body-size limit. An oversized payload (hundreds of megabytes) exhausts the Node.js heap during buffering, producing a fatal V8 out-of-memory error that aborts the process.
